final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender_code, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(row_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.row_count), AVG(g.row_count - o.avg_count) FROM gender_counts g JOIN overall o ON o.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.row_count > o.avg_count
